title: Approvals shows every request to admin, business manager and CEO
description: These roles file nothing and approve nothing, so Approvals was empty for them. Acting as one of them, it now lists every request across the company, read-only.
items: Filter by status: all, pending, approved, rejected, withdrawn
Each pending request shows who it is waiting on: relievers, team leader or manager
Timesheet weeks waiting on the manager are listed underneath
